timeline.summary: On 24 April 2026, Wipro announced a strategic partnership with Kongsberg Digital to jointly deploy AI-powered digital twin solutions for the Energy & Utilities sector, with no value disclosed.
Wipro completed the 100% acquisition of Mindsprint Pte. Ltd. and its subsidiaries on May 15, 2026.
On 15 May 2026, Wipro completed its acquisition of Olam Group's IT and digital services business Mindsprint, which becomes a wholly owned subsidiary with over 3,200 employees.
Shareholders approved Ms. Tulsi Naidu’s re-appointment as Independent Director for 5 years from July 1, 2026, via remote e-voting on May 21, 2026.
Wipro published the public announcement for its ₹15,000 Cr share buyback at ₹250 per share with record date on June 5, 2026.
On 25 May 2026, Wipro issued the public announcement for its ₹15,000 Cr buyback of up to 60 Cr shares at ₹250 each, with a record date of 5 June 2026.
On 28 May 2026, Wipro announced an expanded partnership with ServiceNow to embed agentic AI workflows across core enterprise functions.
On June 1, 2026, Wipro announced that its step-down subsidiary Wipro IT Services, LLC will acquire an additional 20% stake in Aggne Global Inc. for USD 28.5 million, taking its total holding to 80%.

On 2 June 2026, Wipro's board approved proposing B S R & Co. LLP as statutory auditor for five years from the 81st AGM, replacing Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP whose term ends there, subject to shareholder approval; KPMG was approved as the Form 20-F auditor for FY2028.
03 June 2026: Wipro announced the online availability of its FY26 Annual Report on Form 20-F for ADS holders.
Wipro guided Q2FY27 IT services revenue to -1.5% to +0.5% QoQ in constant currency after Q1 margin fell 120 bps YoY to 16%.
On 13 October 2026, Wipro clarified that the U.S. Department of Labor's suspension of new PERM applications will not have a material business impact due to its high local hiring in the U.S.
2026-10-15: Wipro reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹24,818 Cr and PBT of ₹4,205 Cr
On 15 October 2026, Wipro announced through its subsidiary the acquisition of a 20% stake in FLARRE.AI, Inc. for USD 2,000.
2026-10-16: Wipro's Q2FY27 call guided Q3 IT services revenue to -1.5% to +0.5% QoQ in constant currency, with Q2 operating margin at 16.5% and TCV of $2.6 billion.
